remarks: Experience Sophisticated Downtown Living at THE CLASSIC 24/7 Concierge High Rise 25Forest. Step into an inviting Move-In Ready Condo 2BD/2BA/Den-Dining Area thoughtfully designed for privacy and comfort. Featuring a spacious split floor plan, bedrooms sit separated by the living room. Discover a flexible dining area or den or office, Easy one Level Living lifestyle. Enjoy the sunny balcony with beautiful sunsets view. The gourmet kitchen is outfitted with a gas range. One bath offers a sleek walk-in shower, complementing the modern, refined finishes throughout. In-unit Wash/Dry, Includes 1 garage space Deeded! Luxury Amenities: Relax at the resident lounge, fitness center, or unwind on the roof deck. Find a beautifully renovated private park w grills. Luxury Living.
